description: Use when an agent needs to identify or vet a US bank: by name or FDIC cert returns FDIC data: active or closed, charter class, regulator, city/state, website, total assets and report date. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /bank/us, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number (1-6 digits). Use name or cert

name.description: Bank name (phrase match; the largest active match is returned, others listed). Use name or cert

name: bank_us
title: Bank us
